diff_table.current_state: Graph lint reports build-v2-missing-produces for two schema_version=2 decision builds because their produces buckets exist but all buckets are empty.
diff_table.current_project_state: Affected refs: .codewiki/builds/decision/2026-05-29-autonomous-roadmap-orchestration-hardening.json and .codewiki/builds/decision/2026-05-29-checks-policy-gateway-wiki-namespace.json. Both are accepted decision_build artifacts with downstream planning_builds and decision-pass validation reports already present.
diff_table.desired_state: Historical decision builds expose explicit produced refs that the graph can follow, without altering the accepted semantic rows, roadmap status, runtime behavior, or code behavior.
diff_table.agreed_change: Classify this as a historical build-metadata traceability gap. Repair only the produces fields of the two affected decision builds using existing downstream planning/validation refs.
diff_table.expected_final_state: wiki_state and wiki_audit no longer report build-v2-missing-produces for these two files. Any remaining graph-health warnings are unrelated and must not be hidden by this repair.
diff_table.validated_final_state: build-v2-missing-produces count is 0 after wiki_state refresh; remaining graph warnings are large-doc and roadmap-missing-code-path only.
diff_table.rationale: The build contract requires v2 builds to expose consumes/produces edges. These two builds already produced downstream planning and validation evidence; the files failed lint because the edges were not recorded in produces.
alternatives: Change linter to ignore decision builds with deferred row mappings.
Leave warning as known historical noise.
Purge archived builds through post-commit GC once policy allows.
